welcome.title: Kadro
welcome.subtitle: Never play short. Set up your match, find your player.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.subtitle: Get back to your team and matches.

signUp.title: Create account
signUp.subtitle: Join the squad with a few details.
signUp.displayNameHint: Your teammates see you under this name.
signUp.doneMessage: We received your request. We sent a link to this address; tap it to verify your email. If you do not see it in your inbox, check your spam folder.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email address and we will send you a reset link.
forgot.doneMessage: If an account exists for this address, we sent a password reset link. The link is valid for a short time.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.subtitle: Choose a new password for your account.
reset.doneMessage: For your security, every device was signed out. Sign in with your new password.
reset.invalidMessage: This link is not valid or has expired. Request a new reset link.

verify.title: Email verification
verify.doneMessage: Thank you. You can now use every feature.
verify.invalidMessage: This link is not valid or has expired.
